import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

def flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def jsonContent = null
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    jsonContent = inputStream.text
} as InputStreamCallback)

def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(jsonContent)
def responseBody = json.ResponseBody
flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { out ->
    out.write(responseBody.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

def flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def jsonContent = null
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    jsonContent = inputStream.text
} as InputStreamCallback)

def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(jsonContent)
def responseBody = json.ResponseBody

} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def content = ''
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    content = new String(inputStream.bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
} as InputStreamCallback)

def jsonSlurper = new JsonSlurper()
def root = jsonSlurper.parseText(content)

def flatList = []
def flattenCategory

// Hàm đệ quy duyệt cây và trải phẳng
flattenCategory = { category, parentId = null ->
    def record = [
        id: category.id,
        parent_id: parentId,
        name: category.name,
        url_key: category.url_key,
        url_path: category.url_path,
        level: category.level,
        is_leaf: category.is_leaf,
        product_count: category.product_count,
        thumbnail_url: category.thumbnail_url
    ]
    flatList << record

    // Duyệt các danh mục con nếu có
    if (category.children && category.children.size() > 0) {
        category.children.each { child ->
            flattenCategory(child, category.id)
        }
    }
}

flattenCategory(root)

def flatJson = JsonOutput.toJson(flatList)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { outputStream ->
    outputStream.write(flatJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

// Lấy attribute sellerName trước khi xử lý nội dung
def sellerName = flowFile.getAttribute("sellerName") ?: ""
def requestUrl = "https://www.lazada.vn/${sellerName}/?ajax=true&from=wangpu&isFirstRequest=true&langFlag=en&page=1&pageTypeId=2&q=All-Products"

// Gán attribute RequestUrl mới
flowFile = session.putAttribute(flowFile, "RequestUrl", requestUrl)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { inputStream, outputStream -> 
    def text = inputStream.getText('UTF-8')
    def originalJson = new JsonSlurper().parseText(text)

    // Lấy giá trị ResponseBody từ JSON ban đầu
    def responseBody = originalJson.ResponseBody

    // Tạo JSON hard-code và gộp với responseBody
    def hardCodedJson = [
        RequestUrl: requestUrl,
        RequestDomain: "lazada.vn",
        RequestHeaders: [
            "accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
            "accept-language": "vi,en;q=0.9",
            "dnt": "1",
            "priority": "u=1, i",
            "sec-ch-ua": "",
            "sec-ch-ua-mobile": "?0",
            "sec-ch-ua-platform": "",
            "sec-fetch-dest": "empty",
            "sec-fetch-mode": "cors",
            "sec-fetch-site": "same-origin",
            "user-agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/135.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "x-csrf-token": "e350348eeebb1"
        ],
        ResponseBody: responseBody
    ]

    // Chuyển thành JSON đẹp
    def finalJson = JsonOutput.prettyPrint(JsonOutput.toJson(hardCodedJson))

    // Ghi ra output stream
    outputStream.write(finalJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as StreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.time.OffsetDateTime
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return


def content = ''
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    content = new String(inputStream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
} as InputStreamCallback)

def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(content)
if (json.uid) {
	json.url = "https://zalo.me/" + json.uid
	json.phones = [json.uid]
}
json.created_time = OffsetDateTime.now().toString()
def updatedContent = JsonOutput.toJson(json)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { out ->
    out.write(updatedContent.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

properties.Script Body:
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

def flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def jsonContent = null
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    jsonContent = inputStream.text
} as InputStreamCallback)

def json = new JsonSlurper().parseText(jsonContent)
def responseBody = json.ResponseBody
flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { out ->
    out.write(responseBody.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)

This may also be slightly opinionated though, since the circle of people I know are either university students or international people working here; in suburbs people mostly speak 2 languages either French-English or French-Dutch... So objectively, this data may not 100% picture the reality.\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"However, it is worthy to note about the Southeast Asian context of the question - I second \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Steven de Guzman\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"user\", \"uid\": 5430486, \"url\": \"https://www.quora.com/profile/Steven-de-Guzman\"}}}, {\"text\": \" how Indonesian multilingualism is confined within its own borders; we already speak Indonesian and our mother/regional language, so English is just the crowning of it. In Singapore & Malaysia, since English is instituted in their education they have an international advantage. I noticed among my Singapore-Malaysian friends using English in their written assignment/speeches, most of the time they have more elaborate vocabularies/phrases than other fluent English-speaking Asians\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"Yet still, likewise the case in Indonesia, ordinary Singaporeans and Malaysians does not speak proper English - they do speak Singlish or another kind of \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Bahasa Rojak\", \"modifiers\": {\"italic\": true}}, {\"text\": \" / mixed-up language.                                                 "content": "{\"sections\": [{\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"If you\\u2019re going for a two week holiday on one of the very popular tourist destinations, then you\\u2019ll get along fine with English. This year, I had the opportunity to go back to Thailand to (re)learn Thai and have been a student at AUA in Chiang Mai for the past six months \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Learnthai in chiangmai\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"url\", \"url\": \"http://www.learnthaiinchiangmai.com\"}}}, {\"text\": \" as well as Pro Language School \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"https://www.prolanguage.co.th/chiang-mai-branch/\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"url\", \"url\": \"https://www.prolanguage.co.th/chiang-mai-branch/\"}}}, {\"text\": \". School varies a bit, but I have two hours a day of classes, can now have normal conversations in Thai and read texts, though I\\u2019m not yet able to read a full newspaper - but expect to by the end of 12 months. My partner and I have also taken private classes to supplement and there are several reviews of the schools on \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Thai Schools\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"url\", \"url\": \"http://womenlearnthai.com/index.php/learn-thai/thai-schools/\"}}}, {\"text\": \", some written by us, some by others.\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"There are tens of thousands of foreigners, who have made Thailand their home, but who make no effort to learn the language, which means that while they get the benefits of the warm weather, good food and cheap prices, they\\u2019re unable to function without the help of a translator for anything practical.                                                 "content": "{\"sections\": [{\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"If you\\u2019re going for a two week holiday on one of the very popular tourist destinations, then you\\u2019ll get along fine with English. Thailand has some 38 million visitors a year, coming from other countries, and it\\u2019s clear that the vast majority of them don\\u2019t speak Thai and get along just fine.\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"Now, if you\\u2019re living in Thailand for a longer time, then you\\u2019d be well advised to learn some Thai if you\\u2019re going to learn about the culture, traditions, daily life and be able to communicate outside the tourist bubble. I used to live in Thailand as a kid, where I spoke Thai, but sadly, 40 years of lack of use, meant that my language skills pretty well disappeared. This year, I had the opportunity to go back to Thailand to (re)learn Thai and have been a student at AUA in Chiang Mai for the past six months \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Learnthai in chiangmai\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"url\", \"url\": \"http://www.learnthaiinchiangmai.com\"}}}, {\"text\": \" as well as Pro Language School \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"https://www.prolanguage.co.th/chiang-mai-branch/\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"url\", \"url\": \"https://www.prolanguage.co.th/chiang-mai-branch/\"}}}, {\"text\": \". School varies a bit, but I have two hours a day of classes, can now have normal conversations in Thai and read texts, though I\\u2019m not yet able to read a full newspaper - but expect to by the end of 12 months. My partner and I have also taken private classes to supplement and there are several reviews of the schools on \", \"modifiers\": {}}, {\"text\": \"Thai Schools\", \"modifiers\": {\"link\": {\"type\": \"url\", \"url\": \"http://womenlearnthai.com/index.php/learn-thai/thai-schools/\"}}}, {\"text\": \", some written by us, some by others.\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"There are tens of thousands of foreigners, who have made Thailand their home, but who make no effort to learn the language, which means that while they get the benefits of the warm weather, good food and cheap prices, they\\u2019re unable to function without the help of a translator for anything practical. Simply, if you\\u2019re able to have a normal conversation with Thai people in their language, you\\u2019ll get a lot more out of your life there.\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"I\\u2019ll finish with this quote from Nelson Mandela.\", \"modifiers\": {}}], \"indent\": 0, \"quoted\": false, \"type\": \"plain\", \"is_rtl\": false}, {\"spans\": [{\"text\": \"\\u201cIf you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head. import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
import groovy.json.JsonOutput
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import org.apache.nifi.processor.io.StreamCallback

flowFile = session.get()
if (!flowFile) return

def content = ''
session.read(flowFile, { inputStream ->
    content = new String(inputStream.bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
} as InputStreamCallback)

def root = jsonSlurper.parseText(content)

def flatList = []
def flattenCategory

// Hàm đệ quy duyệt cây và trải phẳng
flattenCategory = { category, parentId = null ->
    def record = [
        id: category.id,
        parent_id: parentId,
        name: category.name,
        url_key: category.url_key,
        url_path: category.url_path,
        level: category.level,
        is_leaf: category.is_leaf,
        product_count: category.product_count,
        thumbnail_url: category.thumbnail_url
    ]
    flatList << record

    // Duyệt các danh mục con nếu có
    if (category.children && category.children.size() > 0) {
        category.children.each { child ->
            flattenCategory(child, category.id)
        }
    }
}

flattenCategory(root)

def flatJson = JsonOutput.toJson(flatList)

flowFile = session.write(flowFile, { outputStream ->
    outputStream.write(flatJson.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
} as OutputStreamCallback)

session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)
